The Department of Industry, Science and Resources and our broader portfolio are integral to the Australian Government’s economic agenda. ------------------

The Temperature and Humidity Team maintains and disseminates Australia’s primary standards for temperature, humidity and trace moisture measurement. We deliver high-accuracy calibration and measurement services to Australian industry, government and research organisations in sectors including advanced manufacturing, semiconductor processing, pharmaceuticals, defence and aerospace, clean energy including hydrogen. The team operates specialised humidity generation and measurement facilities covering relative humidity, dew-point and frost-point temperature, and trace moisture in gases. We work within an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited quality system and undertake research and capability development to improve Australia’s national measurement infrastructure.

**The opportunity**

Start or build your scientific or engineering career at Australia’s national measurement authority. With structured training and support from experienced scientists and engineers, you will develop specialist capability in precision temperature and humidity measurement while contributing to nationally significant calibration services and Australia’s primary measurement standards.

**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------

Join a community of professionals committed to technical measurement excellence and cutting-edge research. We invest in advanced facilities, foster collaboration with leading institutions and support innovation. You will work with people who have diverse skill sets including scientists, engineers, policy specialists and regulatory professionals.  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to develop specialist expertise in humidity metrology while working with advanced humidity generation and high-accuracy reference measurement systems. You will build strong capabilities in measurement uncertainty, metrological traceability and laboratory quality systems within an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited environment, while contributing to the design, automation, validation and commissioning of new national measurement capabilities. Working alongside experienced scientists, engineers and metrologists, you will apply your technical skills to solve real-world measurement challenges for Australian industry and research organisations, participate in applied research projects, and progress towards becoming an authorised signatory and recognised technical specialist in humidity measurement.

* Demonstrate sound judgement, initiative and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.

**What you will do**
--------------------

Following structured training and working under the guidance of experienced measurement scientists, you will progressively develop the technical competence, judgement and independence required to become a recognised specialist in humidity measurement. You will:

* Take responsibility for planning, managing and delivering accurate, high-quality calibration and measurement services within agreed timeframes.
* Maintain and improve the laboratory quality system, including validation, verification and quality assurance activities.

#LI-JC1

This Early Careers role will be an ideal opportunity to develop your experience and expertise in Insurance.

AIG Australia is a leading provider of insurance products and services for commercial and personal insurance customers. It includes one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. AIG offers a broad range of products to customers through a diversified, multichannel distribution network. Operating for more than 50 years, AIG has established a reputation as a leading insurer and ally to our multinational, corporate and SME clients.

**Early Career Analyst (Graduate) Program**

At AIG, we are constantly working to ensure that all employees have the training and skills they need to have a rewarding and successful career. Designed with that commitment at its core, our globally centralised Early Career program provides a platform for participants to launch or accelerate their careers. Through a range of approaches including innovative experiential learning and technical training, performance assessments, formalised mentoring, and exposure to senior leaders, our Early Career program offers unparalleled development opportunities for our diverse early career talent.

Whether you’re a recent university graduate or graduates with up to two years of work experience, the program is designed to evolve with the rapid pace of technological advancements and changing employee preferences to ensure that today’s participants become leaders capable of conquering tomorrow’s challenges.

Over the two-year duration of the program, successful candidates will work in a dynamic environment combining formal and experience-based training alongside meaningful and rewarding work experience. Then, guided by experienced professionals, they will put the skills they learn into practice in a supportive corporate environment.

Applications close on 20th December 2026 with the position commencing in March 2027.

**Make your mark in Underwriting**

AIG Underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, and Multinational Clients. We are reimagining how we help customers to manage risk, transforming our operating model and reshaping our role responsibilities and career pathways. The goal is to unlock the full potential in each colleague – empowering our people to grow as insurance professionals and add more value to our customers and AIG.

**How you will create an impact**

Key accountabilities will include but not limited to:

* Assisting underwriters in evaluating insurance applications for product coverage.
* Review risk submissions and determine if they meet underwriting guidelines, relevant underwriting authority and AIG principles.
* Conducting research and analysis on properties, including inspections and assessments.
* Gathering and verifying information from various sources, such as clients, agents, and databases.
* Assisting in the preparation of underwriting reports and proposals.
* Collaborating with other departments, such as claims and sales, to ensure accurate risk assessment.
* Providing support in policy issuance and endorsement processes.
* Maintaining accurate records and documentation of underwriting activities.
* Keeping abreast of industry trends, regulations, and changes in underwriting guidelines.
* Providing excellent customer service to clients and agents, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Candidates MUST have graduated within the last 2 years prior to 2027.
* AIG seeks candidates who have demonstrated outstanding academic and extracurricular achievement, possess strong analytical and interpersonal skills, and are enthusiastic about and committed to the insurance industry.
* Excellent computer skills including the Microsoft Office suite of applications
* A curious nature and a customer service mindset with good communication skills (verbal and written).
* Enthusiastic team player with the ability to optimise business values to clients by delivering high-quality services and positive client experiences to sustain and enhance the customer base.
* Passion for customer service excellence and ability to build, develop and maintain positive relationships
* High level of initiative and ability to prioritise tasks in an agile environment along with excellent time management and organisational ability.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to analyse data and use it for decision-making
* Tertiary qualifications in Commerce, Economics or Law would be desirable.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why team members come together in the office four days per week. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Ready for faster career growth? We would love to hear from you!

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

**Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters**

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

**Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world**

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

**Welcome to a culture of** **inclusion**

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com.
